title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's most photogenic locations, from stunning mountain vistas and turquoise lakes to vibrant bazaars and unique architectural marvels. Capture the beauty of Kazakhstan's former capital.

places.name: Big Almaty Lake (Bolshoe Almatinskoe Ozero)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Reflections of the surrounding peaks in the vibrant blue-green waters, especially during sunrise or sunset.

places.name: Kok Tobe Park
places.priceRange: 3000 KZT (~$6.70) for cable car round trip
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wide-angle shots of the sprawling city below, with the mountains in the distance. Capture the dramatic sunset over Almaty.

places.name: Medeu Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
places.priceRange: Medeu free, Shymbulak cable car ~7000-9000 KZT (~$15.50-20) for full access
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The striking concrete architecture of Medeu against snowy peaks, or the bustling ski slopes and pristine mountain vistas at Shymbulak.

places.name: Ascension Cathedral (Zenkov Cathedral)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The elaborate multi-domed exterior, its vibrant colors contrasting with the surrounding greenery, and the peaceful park setting.

places.name: Charyn Canyon
places.priceRange: 800 KZT (~$1.80) National Park entrance, tours ~8000-15000 KZT (~$18-33)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wide-angle shots of the 'Valley of Castles,' capturing the scale and intricate patterns of the red sandstone formations, especially at golden hour.

places.name: Green Bazaar (Zelyony Bazaar)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Candid shots of vendors, close-ups of exotic fruits and spices, and wide shots capturing the energetic atmosphere of the market.

places.name: Republic Square & Independence Monument
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The towering Independence Monument against the backdrop of the city or sky, wide shots of the square, and details of the 'Golden Man' statue.

places.name: First President's Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The park's large central fountain, seasonal flower displays, and the grand monument, especially during golden hour.

places.name: Arbat (Zhibek Zholy Pedestrian Street)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Candid shots of people, street performers, local artists' creations, and the general lively atmosphere. Focus on interesting architectural details and neon signs at night.

places.name: Almaty Botanical Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Close-ups of exotic flowers and foliage, wide shots of the various themed gardens (e.g., rose garden, conifer grove), and tranquil pathways.

places.name: Central State Museum of Kazakhstan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The expansive exterior facade, the grand entrance hall, and detailed shots of historical artifacts and traditional Kazakh attire.

places.name: Abay Opera House (Kazakh State Academic Opera and Ballet Theater)
places.priceRange: Free for exterior, performance tickets from 3000 KZT (~$6.70)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The grand classical facade, especially during twilight or at night when it's beautifully lit. Long-exposure shots can capture light trails from passing cars.
